title: Catholic Priest Bites Woman Who Refused Confession
description:
A Florida priest was caught on body cameras moments after a heated dispute at a Catholic church service.  Father Fidel Rodriguez, 66, a priest at a church in St. Cloud, admits to biting a visitor during the communion service when he said she reached for the communion bread after he refused to give it to her multiple times. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
